purpose: Route questions to CFA-01 when a change touches World meaning, identity/correspondence, relationships, Space, addressability, projection or Context. Route only the World-side semantic portion.

CFA-02: semantic object/relationship meaning must be durably represented
projection/Context basis must survive storage evolution
CFA-03: command term needs grounding to World
CFA-05: execution outcome may become World state
retry/recovery can target changed World meaning
CFA-08: surface renders or edits semantic World state
CFA-10: runtime state is being treated as World state

priority.P0: semantic corruption, identity collision, second source of truth, existence versus authority collapse, unverified external effect treated as World truth
priority.P1: consequential boundary ambiguity, contract change affecting another CFA, cross-CFA dependency invalidation
priority.P2: useful semantic clarification or evidence changing a provisional World model

anti_absorption_rule: Being asked for a registry, store, cache, graph, permission flag, scheduler, provider map, UI model or runtime singleton is not evidence that CFA-01 owns it. First identify the semantic contract and its actual owner.
